### Criteria for Identification of Slow/Fast Learners {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: slow-fast-criteria-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(knitr)

criteria_df <- data.frame(
    "S. No." = c("1", "1", "2", "2"),
    "Type" = c(
        "Weak Students",
        "Weak Students",
        "Bright Students",
        "Bright Students"
    ),
    "Dept" = c(
        "First Year",
        "Dept",
        "First Year",
        "Dept"
    ),
    "For All Programs / Courses – Odd Sem" = c(
        "On the basis of students' PCM / performance in Assessment Test / CAE-I (say - 40% or less)",
        "Having either Back Paper or SGPA < 6 in Univ. End Sem Result (till previous semester) or having CT marks (say <60%) of all the theory subjects of missing semester (AKTU Result Not available)",
        "On the basis of students' PCM / performance in Assessment Test / CAE-I (say - 75% or more)",
        "Having NO Back Paper and SGPA > 8 in latest available Univ. End Sem Result (Sem / Session)"
    ),
    "For All Programs / Courses – Even Sem" = c(
        "Having either Back Paper or SGPA < 6 in University End Sem Result of Sem-I",
        "",
        "Having NO Back Paper and SGPA > 8 in University End Sem Result (Sem-I)",
        ""
    ),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Common dimensions (inches)
table_widths <- c(0.45, 0.85, 0.65, 1.95, 1.95)

if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {

    library(flextable)

    tbl <- flextable(criteria_df) |>
        theme_booktabs() |>
        merge_v(j = c("S. No.", "Type"), part = "body") |>
        valign(valign = "center", part = "all") |>
        bold(part = "header") |>
        fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
        padding(padding = 4, part = "all") |>
        align(
            j = 1:3,
            align = "center",
            part = "all"
        ) |>
        align(
            j = 4:5,
            align = "left",
            part = "all"
        ) |>
        set_table_properties(
            layout = "fixed",
            opts_word = list(
                repeat_headers = TRUE,
                split = FALSE
            )
        )

    for (j in seq_along(table_widths)) {
        tbl <- flextable::width(
            tbl,
            j = j,
            width = table_widths[j]
        )
    }

    # Emit Word-compatible table markup
    flextable::flextable_to_rmd(tbl)

} else if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    library(kableExtra)

    tbl <- kbl(
        criteria_df,
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        longtable = FALSE,
        align = c("c", "c", "c", "l", "l")
    ) |>
        kable_styling(
            latex_options = "hold_position",
            font_size = 9,
            full_width = FALSE
        ) |>
        column_spec(1, width = "0.45in") |>
        column_spec(2, width = "0.85in") |>
        column_spec(3, width = "0.65in") |>
        column_spec(4, width = "1.95in") |>
        column_spec(5, width = "1.95in") |>
        collapse_rows(
            columns = c(1, 2),
            valign = "middle"
        )

    cat(as.character(tbl), "\n", sep = "")

} else {

    library(kableExtra)

    tbl <- kbl(
        criteria_df,
        format = "html",
        escape = TRUE,
        align = c("c", "c", "c", "l", "l")
    ) |>
        kable_styling(
            bootstrap_options = c(
                "striped",
                "bordered",
                "hover",
                "condensed"
            ),
            full_width = FALSE
        ) |>
        collapse_rows(
            columns = c(1, 2),
            valign = "middle"
        )

    cat(as.character(tbl), "\n", sep = "")
}
```

### Action Taken for Academic Improvement of Slow and Fast Learners {.unnumbered}

#### A. Suggested Actions for Weak Students / Slow Learners {.unnumbered}

The following measures are recommended to improve the academic performance of weak students / slow learners:

a. Conduct revision and doubt-clearing classes.

b. Discuss the basic concepts and fundamentals of the respective subjects/courses.

c. Solve difficult questions from previous University (AKTU) End-Semester Examination question papers.

d. Revise important previously taught concepts for 3–5 minutes at the beginning or end of each lecture.

e. Provide assistance in understanding technical terminology and subject-specific vocabulary.

f. Conduct periodic revision tests to assess learning progress.

g. Implement any additional remedial measures as decided by the respective department or course teacher.

#### B. Suggested Actions for Bright Students / Fast Learners {.unnumbered}

The following enrichment measures are recommended to further enhance the academic performance of bright students / fast learners:

a. Encourage students to solve the complete course question bank.

b. Assign challenging questions from previous University (AKTU) End-Semester Examination question papers.

c. Provide additional practice questions and advanced problem-solving exercises.

d. Assign selected questions from competitive examinations, such as GATE, relevant to the respective course.

e. Implement any additional enrichment activities as decided by the respective department or course teacher.
